citations.assessment: Berakhot uses the explicit son-of formula repeatedly within the Menachem passage.

citations.assessment: Midrash Shmuel names Yudan son of R. Aivu in a separate teaching on the kings of the hosts.
The Eikhah parallel about Menachem reads Yudan in the name of Aivu. The parallel preserves a transmission formula where the Yerushalmi has a patronymic.

notes.text: The Yerushalmi repeats a patronymic within the Menachem narrative. Midrash Shmuel has another occurrence, and Eikhah preserves the transmission formula in the parallel narrative.
